59: // NodeShiftTree is the root of a tree that can be shaped using the Shape method.
60: // Note that multipled shapes of the same tree is meant to be used concurrently,
61: // so use the applicable locking when needed.

63: 	tree *radix.Tree
64:

66: 	dims    Dimension
67: 	shifter Shifter[T]

75: 	}

78: 		mu:      &sync.RWMutex{},

80: 		tree:    radix.New(),

102: 		keys = append(keys, key)

104: 	})

part.text:
Fixed in `hugolib/content_map_page.go:421`. The non-recursive page walk previously tracked only the most recently seen child branch, so a later sibling whose name shared a prefix (e.g. `s1` vs `s1-foo`) could cause descendants of the earlier branch to leak into the collection. It now registers each branch subtree with the walker's `SkipPrefix`, correctly excluding all descendants while still visiting sibling branches.

Validated with:
- `go test ./hugolib/doctree ./hugolib -count=1` — passes.
